This is a senior-level software engineering role (6+ years of experience) on Samsara's Commercial Navigation team, working remotely from the US or Canada. The product is in-app navigation for commercial fleets inside the Samsara Driver app, covering on-road mobile guidance, fuel-aware routing, and session review tooling for fleet managers, built on real-time geospatial and telematics data. The work spans mobile, backend services, and web, with React Native as the primary mobile framework alongside Swift and Kotlin for native modules and in-cab experiences.
